API: withTenant opens its transaction in one round trip (item 10): BEGIN and the transaction-local set_config('app.current_org', ..., true) go to PostgreSQL as one simple-protocol message when the organization id is a canonical UUID (hex and hyphens only, so the literal needs no escaping); any other spelling keeps the parameterized two-round-trip start. Same statements, same order, same transaction-local setting, so RLS is unchanged. Measured on loopback (3000 calls, one SELECT): mean 1.40 -> 1.16 ms, p95 1.71 -> 1.40 ms. Tests: only canonical UUIDs reach the literal (injection strings rejected), both starts see the same rows, the setting does not survive commit or rollback on any of the 16 pooled connections

API: GET /knowledge no longer writes (item 9): the incident-to-candidate capture moved out of GET /knowledge, /knowledge/counts, /knowledge/suggest and /knowledge/:id into the knowledge-capture job (every 15 s, advisory lock 727180): one read-only set-based query finds the organizations with an uncaptured resolved incident or a changed untouched candidate, each gets its capture pass under its own tenant transaction; new candidates reach open pages through the realtime events notification as before.
